$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-whatsapp-bsp-source). Seeds the pre-built `whatsapp-bsp` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's WhatsAppProviderClient (BSP-fallback leg). This is the generic Business Solution Provider relay slot — modelled on CM.com's WhatsApp Business API, which authenticates with an `X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN` request header and accepts a Meta-shaped messages payload. Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the CM.com WhatsApp base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. Operators repoint `location` at their chosen BSP (e.g. Twilio Content API, 360dialog, MessageBird WhatsApp) and set the matching credential header, then flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI. The base URL is admin-owned on the source (no SSRF surface). OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST) — template-approval gating, the 24h session window, provider selection (Meta-primary, this BSP as fallback), STOP opt-out, dedupe and delivery-status reconciliation all stay in the consuming app (pipelinq WhatsAppAdapter); this source is a pure transport.

objects.name: WhatsApp BSP relay
objects.description: Generic WhatsApp Business Solution Provider relay (default base: CM.com WhatsApp Business API). Consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf as the BSP-fallback WhatsApp leg. Dormant placeholder — repoint `location` at your BSP and set its credential header (default models CM.com `X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN`), then enable. Send path follows the BSP's messages endpoint (Meta-shaped JSON body).
